lines.en: Ahh, the afternoon — that magical time sandwiched between day and night.
Not as magical as “noon” itself as that only lasts for sixty seconds, but magical nonetheless.
Which is further evidenced by these two naked girls in a bathtub! Just one of them is having a much easier time than the other for reasons you’re already well aware of.
: Are you just going to sit there and blush the entire time?
: That’s the plan, yeah.
: Weird. I figured you’d be more open to looking at me naked after what happened in your room the other night.
: In my defense, you had your clothes on back then. And I was also not in the strongest state of mind after being yelled at by my mom for trying to fuck your boyfriend.
: Want me to rub your shoulders?
: Don’t touch me. I’ll cum.
: Just relax, okay? I’m not gonna touch you, especially when Chinami is right outside the bathroom. Just think of it like being in the shower at school or the dorms.
: Those are way less...intimate, though. In here, it’s just you and me. Which, up until recently, would have probably been okay? But now, I’m...well...you know. There’s...history and stuff.
: You’re not going to feel weird around me forever now, are you? I was just trying to help you feel better.
: N-No! It won’t be forever! Just...probably for the immediate future since there’s still a lot I’m...confused about when it comes to you.
: Like what? Can I, like...help clear anything up? Or...
: I, uhh...
: You...
: You still...love Sensei...right?
: Yeah. With all of my heart.
: Buuuut...you’re okay with...hooking up with other people now?
: Not anybody. Just you. You’re the only person I’ve ever done anything with apart from Sensei.
: Okay, but...
: Would you have ever done that to...err...with me if you hadn’t found out he’d been hooking up with other people?
: Probably not, no.
: See?! That’s why I’m freaking out! The Chika I know wouldn’t ever do anything like that!
: People change, Rin. I’m not the same girl I used to be. I’m smarter now.
: But are you “smarter” because you want to be? Or because you have to be?
: What?
: I just...you...you’re only the second person I’ve ever done stuff with. And if that was just because you were doing it to, like...get back at Sensei or something...I’m going to feel really shitty.
: It’s not like that at all, Rin. I promise.
: Don’t promise me things like that because I’m just going to get hung up on it. You know how I am.
: I do know how you are, which is why I’d never try and use you for something petty like that.
: So...you wouldn’t do that to try and push me one way or the other?
: Because another thought I had was that...you were kind of just...trying to pull me closer to you so I’d stop thinking about Sensei so much.
: Is that...wrong?
: Yeah...and it really hurts to hear you say that.
: But you see how it must look from my point of view, right?! I followed you for years and nothing happened! But then the second I like your boyfriend, you suddenly want to hook up with me?
: I just wanted to-
: I know you...said you just wanted to make me feel better. I know. But...doing that kind of stuff with other people, like...means something to me, Chika.
: It means something to me too. That’s why I did it.
: But the timing is just...so...off. And you’ve already been getting kind of crazy lately. So in my head it was all just, “does she even realize what she’s doing right now?”
: You keep saying that. Everybody’s saying that. How am I crazy? Just because I don’t look at things the same way as you? Is that it?
: Chika, do you have any idea just how many times you vented to me about being terrified that Sensei was seeing someone else?
: Probably...a lot...I imagine.
: And now you’re just fine with it? What happened to loyalty? What happened to being his and only his?
: That’s not...how love works.
: No, that’s not how love works for him. So it feels like you’re just changing your definition of that to adapt and...I don’t know...protect yourself? Does that make sense?
: I’m sorry, Chika. I know this isn’t the time or place, but...
: I’m really worried about you. And if you’re not okay, you can just talk to me. You don’t have to...you know...
: How long...have you known about him, Rin?
: What?
: When I told you he was seeing other people, you didn’t seem surprised at all.
: How long have you known?
: Do you think it was right of you to hide that? To just keep your mouth shut while I vent to you about fearing something you know is happening?
: No...I don’t think it was right. But I-
: You did it because you wanted to protect me. You didn’t want to see me hurt.
: And...you’re not mad about that?
: Of course I’m mad. I could drown you right now.
: Please don’t. I want to die with my clothes on.
: I don’t intend to. You already told me you’d cum if I touched you and it’d be really degrading to watch you orgasm right before dying.
: I feel like it would be kind of fitting, though. It makes sense that I’d go out like that.
: Well, you’re not going to go out at all. I’m keeping you here forever.
: You’re taking me hostage?! See?! I knew you were going crazy!
: No, I’m keeping you with me forever. How could I ever throw away someone who’d go through so much for my sake?
: I know you hate keeping secrets and I know how hard you must have worked to hide all of that from me. And I’m sure it’s the same for Sensei too since I know you care about him.
: And maybe you’re right. Maybe I...am going out of my way to try and rewrite my thoughts on “love” to try and protect myself. I’m not saying it isn’t possible.
: Well, what are you saying then? Because I still don’t get it. How can you go from being so loyal and so focused on him to pushing me down on the bed and making me cum my brains out?
: I told you the other night. Because I love you.
: But you love me as a friend. Sensei’s the one you actually love.
: Maybe. But that still doesn’t change the fact that I wanted to do what I did that night. I wasn’t just using you. I could never.
: But...
: Hold on. If you wanted to do that and weren’t just confused or trying to push me in one direction, it would mean-
: Don’t...try and figure it out. It’s confusing and weird and...uncharacteristic,  sure. But we don’t need to come up with some clear-cut definition of what that was. It just...was.

: If you and Yumi both think I’m going insane, there’s clearly some merit to it. You guys know me better than anybody. But then, that begs the question — if it’s keeping me happy...what’s the problem?
: Are you happy, Chika? Or are you just pretending to be because you’re afraid of everything falling apart?
: You’ve already lost so much. No one would hold it against you for trying to keep yourself from losing Sensei too.
: I won’t lose Sensei...I’m winning.
: Winning what? Him?
: Yeah...
: He loves me most of all.
: Chika...
: What will happen if you find out he doesn’t?
: If you know something about that, please just keep your mouth shut and don’t risk making me feel even worse. Okay?
: I don’t...know anything about who he loves the most. But I hope for your sake that it is you. If you’re actually fine with that and aren’t just pretending, I mean.
: Can you look at me for a second?
: Hold on...I’m trying not to start crying.
: You can cry if you want. It’s okay.
: Just...hold on. Okay?
: Okay. Hi.
: I love you.
: I love you.
: Do we, like...kiss now? How does this work?
: I don’t know. Like, I want to. But it still feels weird.
: Yeah, same.
: So you, like...like really want to do stuff like that with me then? It’s not all just...for my sake?
: Rin, do you really think I have been flirting and trying to dress you up in cute outfits for so long just because we’re really good friends?
: You...You’ve  been trying to seduce me this whole time?!
: I don’t know if I’d say seduce.
: But I’d definitely be lying if I said I didn’t occasionally imagine the two of us making out in my bed sometimes.
: I need to get out of the bath now.
: Yes. I also need to do that.
: Chinami! How would you feel if big sis Chika started dating girls instead of boys?!
: Are we really going to drag her into this now?
: Chinami wouldn’t care! But she’d be confused if it was big sis Yumi because that would make our family like the Lannisters!
: Also, she’s worried about what would happen to Papa!
: I just wanted to see what she’d say.
: Does she really call Sensei “Papa?”
: Of course. He’s the closest thing to a dad she’s ever had.
: Which...adds one more reason you’re so afraid of losing him. Two hearts would be breaking instead of just one.
: Mhm! But we don’t have to worry about that since he’s never going anywhere.
: Yeah...things will work out for you. They’ve got to eventually.
: I guess you did manage to score this apartment, though. This place seems really nice for what you’re paying for it.
: Right? I have no idea how the Tsukiokas make so much money with rent prices like these.
: Again...it’s gotta be the fucking bubble wrap. I chose the wrong line of work.
: No cursing in front of Chinami. Remember?
: Oh, shit. Sorry.
: Rin. Please.
: What?
: Oh, fuck! I did it again!
: Am I going to need to ban you from my apartment?
: Probably! How the f...frog does Yumi manage to control herself here?!
: Yumi froggin’ loves Chinami and wishes only the froggin’ best for her! That’s how!
: Did you just accidentally corrupt my little sister?
: I’m sorry. You can’t take me anywhere without me ruining everything. Just ban me now.
: You know, if you moved into one of the vacant rooms, I could ban you and we could still hang out here. Then, I wouldn’t ever really need to go back to the dorms either.
: Move in? There are still empty rooms here?
: Yeah, I don’t think all of them are listed yet. You can afford it after your raise, can’t you? Even more so if you bring Futaba along and add in what she gets from her parents.
: Futaba’s parents stopped sending her money a while ago.
: What? They’re not still, like...MIA right?
: She doesn’t seem as worried as she was in the beginning, but...yeah. She hasn’t heard from them in a while.
: Oh my God. I hope they’re okay. And not just because I want you guys to live here too. Futaba is a sweetheart and deserves only the best.
: She’d never try to steal Chinami’s papa. Right, Rin?
: What’s Chinami hearing about somebody trying to steal her papa?! Chinami will froggin’ kill them!
: Chinami better stop using “frog” as a replacement for bad words or big sis Chika is going to take her games awaaaay!
: One day, Chinami will have justice!
: Chika...about...what you just said...
: Should I text Sensei and tell him to come over? This complex is technically for women only, but Touka would definitely bend the rules if it’s for him, right?
: Here?! Now?! Us?! Together?! Pajamas?!
: What’s wrong, Rin? You’re not nervous around him now, are you?
: I am nervous around everyone. It’s part of my nature.
: Theeeeeen should I press send?
: I don’t even know what you wrote yet. Let me-
: Western silverback...
: I’m gonna do it. Here goes-
: Don’t you dare!
: Aah! Chinami! Your sister is under attack! Help!
: Hey! Get your froggin’ hands off of big sis Chika!
: Chinami is grounded now!
: For helping?!
: Chika! Give me the phooooone!
: Neveeeeeeer!
Rin manages to secure the phone and backspaces the message before Chika ever sends it, but surely that doesn’t stop them from thinking about it.
Right?
Surely, he remains the centerpiece of their fantasies.
Right?
Right?
